page.overview:
What is Upper Flagley?

Upper Flagley was a small village in Yorkshire, England. It is one of the many villages throughout Britain where witches and wizards settled in numbers after the International Statute of Secrecy to rely on each other for mutual support, living alongside a Muggle population.

In 1998, Ron Weasley suggested that he, Harry Potter and Hermione Granger might find one of Lord Voldemort's horcruxes there.

Upper Flagley was also the location of the ancestral home of a gentry wizarding family known as the Clokes, as well as the St Oswald's Home for Old Witches and Wizards, a wizarding nursing home for the elderly.
